entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4814"/><div sID="gen7030" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4814"/>5. The Hebrew for "flattery" is "smoothness"; then it came to mean a prey divided by lot, because a smooth stone was used in casting the lots (<reference osisRef="Deut.18.8">De 18:8</reference>), "a portion" (<reference osisRef="Gen.14.24">Ge 14:24</reference>). Therefore translate, "He that delivers up his friend as a prey (which the conduct of my friends implies that they would do), even the eyes," &c. [Noyes] (<reference osisRef="Job.11.20">Job 11:20</reference>). Job says this as to the sinner's children, retorting upon their reproach as to the cutting off of his (<reference osisRef="Job.5.4">Job 5:4</reference>; <reference osisRef="Job.15.30">15:30</reference>). This accords with the Old Testament dispensation of legal retribution (<reference osisRef="Exod.20.5">Ex 20:5</reference>). <div eID="gen7030" type="x-p"/>
